toggleStepExpand.trigger: tap / click on expandable step row
toggleStepExpand.visual: chevron rotates from right to down, subItems or terminal expand with 220ms curve

openArtifact.visual: opens markdown/diff artifact modal or tab

toggleMasterSummary.trigger: tap on master title when completed

stopExecution.trigger: tap on Stop button in header
stopExecution.visual: sends cancellation RPC to daemon/LS, halts spinner
